title: Pricing Data Scientist
description:
PRICING DATA SCIENTIST

£80,000 - £100,000
REMOTE (LONDON OFFICE AVAILABLE)

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing business With significant investment being made across data, technology and pricing, you'll have the chance to help build a modern pricing function from the ground up while taking ownership of high-impact modelling work. If you're looking for autonomy, technical challenge and the opportunity to shape the future direction of a business, this role offers all three.

THE COMPANY

This insurance business is investing heavily in its data and pricing capabilities as part of a wider transformation programme. The pricing function is at an early stage of development, creating a rare opportunity to join as one of the key hires and directly influence how pricing is approached across the organisation. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders and have the opportunity to make a visible impact from day one.

THE ROLE

  • Develop and enhance risk pricing models
  • Support a major transformation programme, including the build of a new Python-based rating engine
  • Deliver end-to-end pricing analysis, modelling and performance monitoring
  • Utilise new and existing data sources to improve risk selection and pricing outcomes
  • Conduct customer segmentation and wider analytical projects to support business growth
  • Work closely with pricing, underwriting and data stakeholders across the organisation
  • Take ownership of projects and contribute to the development of a growing pricing function
  • Influence technical direction and help establish best practices within the team

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Strong commercial experience developing GLM and/or GBM pricing models
  • Proven background in risk pricing, rather than commercial or optimisation pricing
  • Experience within personal lines insurance, such as motor, home, pet, travel or van insurance
  • Strong Python and SQL skills
  • Experience working across the full pricing model lifecycle
  • Ability to communicate complex analytical findings to a range of stakeholders
  • Strong academic background
  • Experience with pricing transformation projects would be advantageous

SALARY AND BENEFITS

  • Base salary of £80,000 - £100,000
  • Remote-first working model
  • London office available for those who wish to attend
  • Significant ownership and autonomy
  • Opportunity to help build and shape a growing pricing function
  • Exposure to large-scale transformation and modern pricing technology
  • Clear progression opportunities as the team expands

HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest by sending your CV to Rachael through the 'Apply' link.
